text:
natalie: CI red on PR #8123 — image publish step failed when pushing the image from staging-bastion-2. Error in publish job: HTTP 401 Unauthorized (token invalid). Anyone seen this after the token rotation earlier today?

ci-bot: [CI] job 'pr-8123/publish-image' failed (exit code 1) — see logs: https://ci.internal/jobs/8123

omar: which bastion is it? staging-bastion-1 or -2?

natalie: staging-bastion-2. Build succeeded, push step errored during layer upload with auth. Snippet:```
unauthorized: authentication required
Detail: WWW-Authenticate: Bearer error="invalid_token", error_description="The access token has expired"```

kevin: we've hit this before — the bastion runs a credential helper that caches a short-lived token. When the central token rotation happens the helper doesn't always refresh cleanly. Quick fix is to restart the helper / flush the docker credential cache on that host.

sam: can you rerun the job after the flush? I can ssh and restart the helper now if you want.

omar: also check the CI worker's environment does not have a stale `DOCKER_CONFIG` mounted from the bastion. Sometimes the proxy injects an old config into the job container.

natalie: on it. I'll ssh to staging-bastion-2 and restart the credential process and delete any tmp creds. Running:
```
ssh staging-bastion-2
sudo systemctl restart credential-cache.service
sudo rm -f /tmp/docker-cred-* /var/lib/docker/creds/*
```

infra-bot: credential-cache.service restarted on staging-bastion-2 by natalie. Cleared 2 cached entries.

natalie: requested a rerun of job pr-8123/publish-image (rerun by @natalie)

ci-bot: [CI] rerun started for job 'pr-8123/publish-image' (triggered by natalie)

ci-bot: [CI] rerun succeeded — image pushed to registry and tags updated.

kevin: thanks — I'll follow up with a small change to the bastion bootstrap: add a periodic cache refresh and a CI pre-step to validate token before pushing.

natalie: nice, thanks for the quick eyeballs. Closing the triage on my side. :thumbsup:

sam: noted — I can add a check to the pipeline: `docker login --username ci-bot --password-stdin` dry-run before push to fail fast.

omar: filing a small infra task to avoid recurrence.

kevin: /assign me for the infra task.

natalie: awesome — resolved.
